entities.name: Cotton Domestication
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Cotton was independently domesticated in India and Peru. Indian cotton textiles were so fine that Greeks called them "woven wind." The Indus Valley civilization mass-produced cotton fabric at an industrial scale.
